schedule: Daily 05:30 EAT after nightly ETL (plus intra-day for payments)
owner_role: CDM Admin (IT Manager acts as interim Data Steward lead)

checks.measure: (matched duplicate rows + open review rows) / total customers
checks.escalation_role: CRM Officer -> Data Governance Council (if > 2% for 3 days)
checks.remediation_script: python module2_data_quality/dq_assessment_cleansing.py --stage dedupe && open MDM review queue

checks.escalation_role: CRM Officer (entry-point fix) / IT Operations Lead (integration fix)
checks.remediation_script: python scripts/dq_check.py --metric phone_validity; re-run standardize_phone() backfill

checks.measure: rows resolving to official district list / non-null districts
checks.alert_threshold: < 99.5% or any new unresolved label pattern > 50 rows/day
checks.remediation_script: python module2_data_quality/dq_assessment_cleansing.py --stage profile; add alias to DISTRICT_VARIANTS after steward approval

checks.escalation_role: CRM Officer -> Store Manager (data capture at POS)
checks.remediation_script: python scripts/dq_check.py --metric completeness; launch capture-form fix at offending stores

checks.measure: rows in controlled vocabulary / total products
checks.remediation_script: python module2_data_quality/dq_assessment_cleansing.py --stage products; block non-conforming item setup in Odoo

checks.measure: count of SKUs mapped to >1 active product
checks.remediation_script: SQL: sku_collision_report.sql; quarantine batch and re-issue SKU

checks.measure: quarantined rows / rows staged per nightly run
checks.remediation_script: python module3_etl/srg_etl_pipeline.py --inspect-quarantine; fix source, replay from quarantine

checks.measure: count of MoMo/Airtel transactions with NULL payment_ref aged > 24h
checks.remediation_script: SQL: reconcile_momo_pending.sql (match provider CSV downloads); auto-close or write off with approval
python scripts/dq_check.py --metric dates; block offending registration form

checks.measure: count of active SKUs with selling_price < cost without promo flag
checks.remediation_script: SQL: margin_anomaly_report.sql; business decision - never auto-corrected by ETL
